title-line: A boulder. A pit. A few people in between.
obj-rock: Hit the boulder to save the quadragen!
obj-props: Maybe a wooden roof will stop the next boulder?
obj-arch: Let's build an arch of ore and stone. She'll take it.
obj-dome: There are no more ideas, maybe the wizards will help.

row-unlockapothecary-note: brewing temporary reinforcements for your quad workers
row-unlockcasino-note: A table that accepts a bet and pays double or nothing
row-unlockouthouse-note: You've seen enough poop, let's clean it up.

row-dome-note: Everything from the ground didn't work. What is left is not of the earth.
row-net-note: It didn't work out, maybe catch a boulder with a net?

row-wizpower-note: Each lightning bolts off 5 cells instead of 5.

row-roomba-note: Goes to the mud in the open yard and takes her home; they are looked after by a janitor, and they smoke.
row-recycler-note: What catches balls falls with pebbles, not dirt.

hover-counter: stones in the pit: they pay for everything
